sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: General Partner Management Entity for Early-Stage Technology Funds

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic legal family, codified commercial law under Código de Comercio, administrative law under Ley 1437 de 2011)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force May 2012, investment chapter)
Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (in force August 2011)
Colombia-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 2014)
Andean Community investment instruments (Decision 291 and Decision 292 of the CAN Commission)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF), Ley 1121 de 2007 (AML/CFT duties), Ley 2155 de 2021 Article 71 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB), DIAN Resolution 164 de 2022 (RUB registration procedure and beneficial owner threshold), Decreto 2555 de 2010 (venture capital fund and GP regulation), Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia Circular Básica Jurídica - Circular Externa 029 de 2014 as updated by Circular Externa 002 de 2022, and FATF Recommendations 1, 5, 10 and 12.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - RUB beneficial ownership data is filed with DIAN and is confidential, accessible only to tax, customs, UIAF and judicial authorities; no public UBO register exists in Colombia.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Corporate Existence of the foreign fund's General Partner or institutional investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the country of incorporation (e.g., Delaware Division of Corporations, Companies House, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a State Party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961; consular legalization by the Colombian Consulate applies only for non-Convention jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Colombian legal representative for incorporation and SFC licensing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of identification documents (passports) of all ultimate beneficial owners and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or notarized certification where accepted by Colombian chambers)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / KYC letter evidencing committed venture capital funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank holding escrow, custody or capital commitment accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or authenticated signature by the bank's legal representative)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation of the foreign fund's limited partnership agreement / LLC agreement and GP constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official sworn translator (traductor oficial) registered in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required; translator's certification is accepted by Colombian notaries, the Chamber of Commerce and the SFC

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, legal representatives, directors and investment-committee members against the OFAC SDN list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated List, the Colombian UIAF consolidated lists, and national and international PEP databases; enhanced due diligence is compulsory for PEPs, their family members and close associates; ongoing monitoring of ownership and transactions is required by Circular Básica Jurídica (Circular Externa 029 de 2014, as updated) and FATF Recommendations 1, 10 and 12; a risk-based approach with written AML policy and a designated compliance officer is mandatory before the SFC authorization application is filed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by Confecámaras (https://www.rues.org.co) through the local Chamber of Commerce; for Bogotá the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá portal (https://www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The S.A.S. denomination must end with the token 'S.A.S.' pursuant to Ley 1258 de 2008, Article 5, and must be expressed in Roman characters. The name must be in Spanish or in universally understood commercial terms; foreign words are admissible only under the Chamber's assimilation doctrine and must be transliterated to Roman script with accent normalization for RUES indexing. The proposed name must not collide with existing registered denominations or trademarks (homonymy and confusing similarity rules under Código de Comercio and the SIC).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco - requires prior authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC)
Seguros / Reaseguros - requires prior SFC authorization
Bolsa / Bolsa de Valores / Valores - requires prior SFC authorization
Fondo de Pensiones / Fondo de Cesantías - requires prior SFC authorization
Sociedad Administradora de Fondos de Inversión - requires prior SFC authorization
Fondo de Capital Privado / Gestor Profesional - requires prior SFC authorization under Decreto 2555 de 2010 for venture capital GP activity
Cooperativa / Mutual - requires prior authorization from the Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria
Nacional / Presidencia / Instituto - requires prior ministerial authorization
Military, police and public insignia terms - requires prior Ministry of Defense authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may be renewed once for a further 30 days upon application to the Chamber of Commerce before expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber of Commerce and a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) before Confecámaras within 10 business days of notification (Ley 1437 de 2011, Articles 74, 77 and 79). Where the rejection is based on homonymy with an existing registered name, the applicant may petition the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for a priority ruling or request cancellation of the conflicting registration; filing a new reservation under a materially different name is the expedited alternative while any appeal remains pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: PROHIBITED as the registered main office for the regulated venture capital GP. Decreto 2555 de 2010 and SFC supervisory criteria require a physical establishment in Colombia from which the GP performs substantive functions (management direction, investment-committee meetings, due diligence, bookkeeping and AML compliance). A virtual address is acceptable only as an ancillary correspondence point for the non-regulated holding entity; it is never acceptable as the SFC-registered principal office of the licensed GP.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections: HIGH (approximately 55% probability within the first 24 months) for SFC-regulated venture capital GPs subject to in-situ supervision; MEDIUM (approximately 30%) for DIAN/UIAF targeted AML and tax inspections; LOW (approximately 5%) for routine Chamber of Commerce registry verifications.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name pre-reservation and RUES electronic filing fee (name search, reservation and one renewal option)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (local Chamber of Commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff in the annual Chamber fees schedule issued under Decreto 1074 de 2015

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation, S.A.S. bylaws drafting and corporate governance structuring for the venture capital GP (4-6 hours of senior capital markets counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (hourly rate of USD 500-800 per senior partner hour)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the private incorporation document and authentication of signatures
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff under Decreto-ley 960 de 1970

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration of the incorporation document and issuance of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff: registration fee plus registration tax of 0.7% on subscribed capital, calculated on minimum capital scenario

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: DIAN RUT pre-inscription and electronic signature (token) issuance for the future entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative cost of the digital certificate and token; RUT pre-registration itself has no nominal statutory fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of foreign GP constitutional documents, certificates of good standing, powers of attorney and passport copies (5 instruments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority in the country of origin and, where applicable, the Colombian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention per-document tariff and Colombian consular legalization fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official sworn Spanish translation of foreign corporate and fund documents (approximately 20-30 pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traductor Oficial (official sworn translator) registered in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 8-12 per page for certified translations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry (RUB) profiling and DIAN registration compliance (beneficial owner identification, control-chart analysis, structured filing preparation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local tax and AML compliance advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for full RIP/RUB structured filing engagements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU and UIAF consolidated-list screening of all UBOs, directors and investment-committee members, including initial adverse-media due diligence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML screening database provider and compliance consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark (annual SaaS subscription plus professional screening fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SFC (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia) authorization application for the venture capital GP under Decreto 2555 de 2010 - legal preparation, supporting exhibits and filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian capital markets counsel and the SFC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory benchmark and time-based professional fees (10-14 hours of specialist counsel work)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office physical premises pre-leasing for the GP (two-month deposit plus first monthly rent for a small executive office in Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of approximately USD 700 per month for Grade-B executive office space in Bogotá

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account pre-opening KYC and UBO compliance package in a Colombian bank (certified board resolutions, UBO declarations, legalization letters and reference forms)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank benchmark tariff for corporate onboarding and KYC administration

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, Arts. 1, 4, 5, 17, 19 and 22); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, Arts. 110-126 (mercantile registry); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES); Decreto 1242 de 2013 and Ley 964 de 2005 (private equity fund manager supervision); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1072 de 2015 (occupational safety, if hiring).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the chosen corporate domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); pre-registration and tax ID with DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales); supervisory oversight by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; fund-manager authorization by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) signed by all shareholders and filed for Mercantile Registry entry; must be executed via escritura pública if real estate assets are contributed or if shareholders elect public instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 1258 de 2008; authorized, subscribed and paid capital are freely determined in bylaws. Payment terms are flexible, but subscribed capital must be paid within the term fixed in the incorporation document; no bank escrow is required for standard S.A.S. formation. However, to act as general partner of a Colombian private equity fund, the SFC imposes ongoing minimum capital/patrimony requirements verified at the fund-licensing stage (Decreto 1242 de 2013; SFC Circular Básica Contable).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 - INITIAL CORPORATE SESSION OF [COMPANY] S.A.S. The shareholders and board of directors, having subscribed the entire authorized capital, resolve: 1. Capital Subscription. The issuance and full payment of [___] ordinary shares to the initial shareholders is ratified. 2. Registered Office. The registered office is fixed at [address], [city], Colombia. 3. Officer Appointments. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative/President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Compliance Officer, with powers under the bylaws. 4. Authorization. The Legal Representative is empowered to register the company with the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN, to open bank accounts, and to execute all ancillary documents. Resolved and minuted in session on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name clearance and homonymy verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended domicile (RUES online system)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the Chamber's virtual matriculate pre-check or in-person window. The system verifies that the names do not conflict with existing trademarks or registered entities and issues the 'Certificado de Homonimia'. The certificate is valid for 90 days and is a prerequisite for filing the incorporation document.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if a third party files on behalf of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged as nontrivial similarity, select an alternative from the submitted list or file a priority/opposition claim with the Chamber's registry office and await the Registrar's decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and legalization of the incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (if deed required) or directly before the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws of the S.A.S. including corporate name, domicile, permitted ISIC activities (code 6499), capital structure, share classes, representation clauses, fiscal year and dissolution causes. If capital contributions consist solely of cash, execute a private document; if real estate or certain publicly registrable assets are contributed, the document must be granted before a notary and registered in the relevant public registry.
required_dossiers: None (prepared document signed by all shareholders)
Certified copies of shareholder ID cards
Proof of address of the registered office (utility bill or lease agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Chamber or notary returns observations (e.g., missing corporate purpose or representation limitation), amend via addendum to the document and resubmit; any refusal can be challenged by the 'recurso de reposición' within 10 business days before the same registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax pre-registration and provisional NIT via DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (MUISCA virtual portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the preliminary Registro Único Tributario (RUT) form using the provisional bylaws and selected economic activity codes (ISIC 6499; CIIU 6499). DIAN assigns a provisional NIT, which is then used when filing with the Chamber of Commerce to accelerate integration. The applicant obtains a PDF of the RUT with provisional status.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or requires correction, adjust the RUT parameters (economic activity, tax responsibilities, address) in MUISCA and resubmit within the same virtual session; a physical DIAN appointment can be scheduled if the system fails.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and registration with the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation document, homonymy certificate and provisional RUT to the Mercantile Registry office, either physically or through the RUES online portal. Pay the registration tariff (derechos de inscripción) and the Chamber enrollment fee. Upon successful review, the Chamber issues the 'Certificado de Matrícula Mercantil' proving legal existence of the S.A.S. and including the assigned NIT.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of legal representative and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry returns a 'requerimiento' (inconsistency note), cure the observations and resubmit within 10 business days. If the Chamber refuses registration, file 'recurso de reposición' before the same authority and, ultimately, 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT activation and e-invoicing enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Matrícula Mercantil certificate, enter MUISCA and confirm the RUT in definitive status; add all tax obligations, including the electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) and the CREE/ICA-dependent responsibilities. Obtain the final RUT document as proof of the tax ID.
required_dossiers: Email and mobile number for DIAN notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal presents inconsistencies between the Chamber data and DIAN records, the legal representative must attend a DIAN office with physical certificate copies; the agent may also file a written petition through DIAN's PQRS channel to accelerate synchronization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization of corporate and accounting books
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of registration, present the corporate books (libro de actas, registro de accionistas) and accounting books (diario y mayor) to the Chamber for stamping and legalization. The company may alternatively register approved electronic accounting records under the 'Registro de Libros Electrónicos'. Pay the corresponding book-sealing tariff.
required_dossiers: Board resolution approving the use of books
Physical books in compliance with Decreto 2649 de 1993 or evidence of electronic system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of late filing, apply for 'legalización extemporánea' and pay the late fee (tarifa de extemporaneidad); the Chamber will calculate the surcharge and legalize the books after payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank account and SFC registration readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks; Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for fund-manager activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account using the Chamber certificate, NIT, bylaws and officer IDs; banks perform enhanced AML/KYC verifications consistent with the Medium-Risk Enhanced tier of the venture capital GP. At this stage, structure the compliance file for eventual SFC authorization under Decreto 1242 de 2013, including the AML/SARLAFT manual, compliance policy, and appointment of the compliance officer, so that capital calls and fund management may start once the SFC certificate is filed.
required_dossiers: Identification of legal representative and shareholders
AML/KYC forms and proof of paid-in capital
SARLAFT manual and compliance officer appointment (to be used in SFC filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank rejects the account due to enhanced AML screening, provide additional source-of-funds documentation and reapply at another regulated bank; if SFC queries the GP registration, amend the internal manual and refile through the SFC virtual window (SIPAD) with legal counsel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) - Directorate for Funds and Collective Investment Vehicles (authorization for private equity GP); municipal planning office (Curaduría Urbana) for land-use compatibility of the registered office; local fire department for occupancy clearance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: SFC registration/authorization as manager of a private equity fund under Decreto 1242 de 2013 and SFC External Circulars (registro como gestor de fondos de capital privado); complemented by the municipal 'Certificado de Uso del Suelo' and 'Certificado de Bomberos' for the office premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, via the Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or Municipal Environmental Authority of the corporate domicile
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Exempt from full EIA: office-based professional activity (ISIC 6499) producing no industrial emissions; only the municipal 'Certificado de Compatibilidad de Uso Ambiental' is required where the lease is in a mixed-use building, plus a basic environmental compliance statement.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC sources; compliance with Resolution 0631 de 2015 for domestic discharge limits where applicable; prohibition of uncontrolled disposal of hazardous residues under Decreto 4741 de 2014; internal air quality per Resolution 2254 de 2017; electronic waste must be handed to an authorized recycler; minimal office generation does not require an external emission permit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification ('Certificado de Bomberos') obtained before operation of the physical office, covering emergency exits, extinguishers, electrical network and evacuation plan; structural/occupancy clearance evidenced via the lease plus 'Certificado de Uso del Suelo' from the municipal planning authority; occupational health and safety system (SG-SST) registered with the respective ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) pursuant to Decreto 1072 de 2015, including mandatory occupational risk class selection prior to hiring staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal (Muisca/SIE): www.muisca.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian S.A.S. obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) automatically upon formal incorporation: (1) execute public deed before a Colombian notary; (2) register the company with the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce); (3) DIAN assigns the NIT through the Chamber of Commerce registration integration; (4) the legal representative and the company must complete online RUT (Registro Único Tributario) activation and fingerprint verification via the Muisca portal; (5) non-resident shareholders must appoint a domiciled legal representative in Colombia with registered power of attorney; (6) update RUT with the 'responsable de IVA' status and any ICA registration as applicable. There is no minimum capital requirement for SAS, and 100% foreign ownership is permitted. Foreign companies without a local permanent presence that must invoice or act in Colombia obtain a separate non-resident NIT through a DIAN-registered proxy.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - a Colombian S.A.S. is an autonomous corporate income taxpayer under the ordinary regime (Régimen Ordinario). No pass-through or transparent treatment is available for income tax purposes at the entity level. Corporate income tax is levied at the statutory rate of 35%, and outbound dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders may be subject to additional dividend withholding under Colombian domestic law and applicable tax treaty provisions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a US-style check-the-box election. Mandatory corporate taxation applies to all S.A.S. entities. Limited statutory elections include: (i) the Simplified Taxation Regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación - SIMPLES) under Law 2010/2019, available for qualifying small businesses with gross income up to 105,000 UVT, which replaces ordinary income tax and VAT reporting with a combined presumptive tax; (ii) elections between annual and bimonthly/quarterly IVA filing frequencies based on gross income thresholds and responsible-party category; (iii) formal disclosure of hybrid mismatch arrangements for BEPS Action 2 purposes (Law 2277/2022) where the S.A.S. participates in cross-border hybrid instruments; and (iv) designation of the foreign-exchange intermediary bank for export proceeds repatriation. There is no consolidated income tax return regime or group relief election for unrelated venture-capital fund structures.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_classification_details: The S.A.S. is subject to entity-level Colombian income tax on worldwide income if managed/controlled in Colombia or on Colombian-source income if treated as a non-resident. A venture-capital GP S.A.S. managing offshore funds must carefully analyze permanent-establishment exposure for partner and carried-interest receipts. The default classification is a fully taxable Colombian resident company, and no transparent election is allowed.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Valor Agregado) under Articles 420 et seq. of the Estatuto Tributario; supplementary national excise: Impuesto Nacional al Consumo (INC) and Impuesto de Timbre for specific goods/services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Commercial legal entities such as a Colombian S.A.S. are mandatory IVA-responsible parties (responsables del régimen común) whenever they carry out any taxable act in Colombian territory; there is no general de minimis turnover exemption for corporations. Natural persons and informal merchants are excluded from VAT-responsible status where their gross income is below 3,500 UVT per year (COP 174,296,500 for tax year 2025, UVT = COP 49,799). A venture-capital GP entity issuing management fee invoices from Colombia is therefore required to register for IVA from inception, regardless of turnover. Foreign digital-service suppliers are separately required to register for VAT on digital services when providing services to Colombian non-VAT-responsible individuals or entities, with no turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates real-time fiscal clearance through DIAN e-invoicing (factura electrónica de venta - FEV). All IVA-responsible parties must: (1) obtain authorization and invoice-set ranges (sets de facturación) from DIAN; (2) issue invoices exclusively through DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free web application; (3) transmit the XML invoice to DIAN via SOAP/REST web services before or simultaneously with delivery to the client; (4) include the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS digital stamp and QR code; and (5) process the client's digital acceptance/rejection event within 48 hours of transmission. Credit notes, debit notes, and equivalent documents follow the same real-time validation. For venture-capital GP fee billing, e-invoicing applies to every management fee, carried-interest arrangement, and expense rebate regardless of amount; the system imposes interoperability via the national RADIAN electronic-receivable infrastructure.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for 0% VAT when the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory under an accepted export declaration, the exporter holds a valid RUT with export status, and the foreign currency proceeds are negotiated/repatriated within the legal deadline. Services qualify as zero-rated exported services (servicios exportados, Article 481 E.T.) where: (i) the service is rendered to a foreign recipient without domicile in Colombia; (ii) the service is not deemed to be used or exploited in Colombia; (iii) the contract is executed in compliance with Colombian foreign-exchange and transfer-pricing rules; and (iv) the benefit of the service is materially received abroad. For a venture-capital GP, offshore management, administration, advisory, and carried-interest-related services performed for a fund organized outside Colombia may qualify, provided the recipient has no Colombian domicile and the service is genuinely consumed in the fund's jurisdiction. Intellectual-property and software-development services exported by a Colombian SAS also qualify if the title/beneficial use passes abroad. The VAT credit mechanism applies to input VAT for exported goods/services, allowing subsequent refund or compensation through DIAN.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) filed through DIAN/VUCE and validated in the SIGLO XXI/SOFIA customs system
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing physical exit of the goods from Colombian customs territory
Commercial export invoice with mandatory CUFE e-invoice stamping identifying the exporter and foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate (certificado de giro de divisas) issued by the Colombian intermediary bank proving collection and repatriation of foreign currency

Service export contract (for offshore management fees / carried-interest / advisory services) specifying the non-resident beneficiary, scope of service, and place of effective use abroad, together with evidence that the service was not exploited in Colombia
Valid RUT and NIT registration certificates of the exporter and any required certificates (e.g., export marketing certificate or proof of the foreign beneficiary's non-domiciled status)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DIAN determines that the zero-rating or VAT refund claim is false, inexact, or unsupported (e.g., simulated service exports, untimely repatriation, incomplete documentation, or proceeds never collected), the following consequences apply: (i) retrospective assessment of the 19% IVA differential, recalculated from the original invoice date, plus default interest (intereses moratorios); (ii) sanción por inexactitud under Article 648 E.T., as amended by Law 2277/2022, equal to 100% to 200% of the higher tax determined; (iii) additional fines for issuing irregular e-invoices or non-compliant export documentation, including cancellation of invoice-set authorizations; (iv) exclusion or suspension from exporter status and denial of future VAT refund/compensation requests until correction; (v) criminal liability for tax evasion, customs fraud, or money laundering under Law 1762/2015 if intentional falsity or smuggling is established, carrying imprisonment and substantial fines; and (vi) joint liability of the legal representative and auditors where wrongful signatures or certifications are involved. DIAN heavily audits cross-border service-export claims by venture-capital and knowledge-process entities, requiring contemporaneous evidence of the overseas benefit and full foreign-exchange trail.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) as the supervisory authority for the financial system; legal framework consisting of Ley 9 de 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of Banco de la República.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso operates under a managed floating exchange-rate system and is freely convertible. Current-account transactions are generally performed without prior central bank authorisation, while capital-account operations are liberalised but must be reported and, where applicable, settled through authorised intermediaries in the Mercado Cambiario. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident investors are legally permitted after local tax compliance, including payment of income tax and any remittance tax, and are conditional on previous registration of the foreign investment with Banco de la República and submission of audited financial statements and the required tax clearance certificate. The main hurdles are regulatory registration, documentary formalities, and indirect tax costs rather than exchange-control rationing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The GP itself does not generally enter into Colombian export transactions. If the GP, a managed fund, or a special-purpose export entity invoices foreign clients for software development or digital services, Colombian exchange law requires export proceeds received in foreign currency to be repatriated and channelled through the authorized foreign exchange market. The statutory standard is collection and channeling within six months from the shipment or service-completion date, with possible Banco de la República sanctioned extensions. The mandatory conversion ratio for eligible export proceeds is 100% of the foreign-currency amount; non-compliance can trigger exchange-fine proceedings by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia. Exports arising from venture-capital portfolio operations should follow the same regime when the operative exporter is a Colombian entity.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Capital Call Collection Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMIs are not authorised in Colombia as deposit-taking banks or as principal custodians of venture-fund assets. They cannot effectively satisfy the foreign-investment registration requirements, FX channeling obligations, or SFC oversight expectations. They may serve only as supplementary euro or USD disbursement channels for minor operational payments, not as the main rail for capital calls, FX conversion, or profit distributions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical opening interview is generally required for a medium-risk-enhanced corporate client such as a venture-capital general partner. The legal representative, primary shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners must be identified; a Colombian branch interview or bank-authorized videoconference plus local legal representative attendance is the commercial standard. Directors signing from outside Colombia must provide a power of attorney legalised by notary and Colombian consulate or by apostille, together with the original corporate resolution. Purely remote onboarding is generally unavailable for this business classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBOs or source-of-funds located in a high-risk or FATF-monitored jurisdiction, or a complex offshore trust structure with unclear economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current share register and company certificates; complete UBO declaration and register; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds narrative with supporting bank statements; audited financial statements for each material shareholder; licensed-counsel legal opinion on anti-money-laundering risk; group structure diagram showing commercial rationale; tax residence certificates; CRS/FATCA self-certifications; apostilled or consularised identification and corporate vouchers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fund-manager classification as Medium-Risk Enhanced, with irregular capital-call timings and a cross-border investor base.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fund placement memorandum and private offering document; limited partnership agreement; GP management agreement; SFC registration certificate under Decree 2555/2010 for the private-equity fund and the GP; subscription agreements and accredited-investor questionnaires; AML/CFT manual adopted by the compliance officer; investor KYC files; capital-call notices and bank payment instructions; transaction-monitoring programme documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital-call wire received from a jurisdiction subject to enhanced surveillance, or involving a politically exposed person (PEP) as investor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP declaration and status; independent negative-news and sanctions screening report; lawful-origin evidence from investor; investor bank account statements and tax filings; passport and resident proof; notarised and apostilled corporate records; explanation of the underlying technology-fund investment strategy; confirmation that the payment originated from an account in the investor's own name.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound disbursement to a portfolio company in a grey-listed jurisdiction or with a use-of-funds description insufficiently connected to a technology venture.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment and shareholders' agreements; term sheet and due-diligence report on the target; approved business plan and line-item use-of-funds budget; target entity corporate record and beneficiary-owner register; board resolution authorising the investment; evidence of the target's substantive operations such as payroll, office lease, and software development contract; sanctions and adverse-media screening results; post-disbursement monitoring and allocation report.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from non-resident investors must be routed exclusively through SWIFT or correspondent banking to a segregated operational account at a Colombian authorised exchange intermediary. Each inbound remittance must reference the relevant capital-call notice and must be accompanied by the investor's foreign-investment registration filing with Banco de la República through Form No. 4 / Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional, using the appropriate DCIN-83 purpose code for contributions to private capital funds. The Colombian managed fund or GP must verify the investor's legal name, tax identification, country of residence, source of funds, and exact capital-allocation reference before crediting the account. Matching is made against the capital-call certificate; no cash payments, crypto-asset transfers, or unregulated intermediaries are acceptable. The bank will generate an FX declaration or domestic exchange-documentation record, and the investment must remain traceable from the foreign investor's account through the Colombian fund's local account to downstream portfolio disbursements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for outbound cross-border trade and investment disbursements is SWIFT MT103 for wire transfers and MT202 COV for bank-to-bank settlement, with full beneficiary and purpose references. For local peso disbursements, Colombian financial institutions clear through the Banco de la República-operated CUD system, ACH Colombia, and real-time low-value clearing rails. Commercial letters of credit remain available for portfolio companies requiring trade-finance-backed inventory or receivables, issued under ICC UCP600 via a Colombian bank using MT700/SWIFT messages. For a venture-capital GP, letters of credit are not standard capital-disbursement instruments; they are retained only for underlying portfolio trade or working-capital transactions. All outbound transfers must incorporate OFAC/FATF sanctions screening, AML transaction monitoring, and, if applicable, the corresponding Colombian FX declaration for repatriation of investment or payment of cross-border services.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable over-the-counter Colombian Peso-US Dollar FX forward contracts executed with an SFC-authorised local bank or foreign bank with a Colombian branch

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/COP for hedging currency exposure arising from committed foreign capital calls or future portfolio distributions, where clearly matched to an exposure and documented for internal risk management
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD/COP for long-dated matching of foreign-currency commitments and local-currency operating funding
Plain-vanilla option contracts on USD/COP, including puts and calls, restricted to hedging actual or expected investment cash flows and not for speculative trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Renewal of the Mercantile Registration), including the GP office commercial establishment registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile (filed via RUES online portal); framework supervised by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within January 1 – March 31 following each fiscal year-end; no anniversary-based extension for calendar-year S.A.S. filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine under Article 3, Law 1429/2010: 0.5% of net equity for up to 30 days late, 0.75% for 31–90 days late, 1.0% beyond 90 days late, capped at 100 SMMLV (≈ USD 34,000); registry marked 'unrenewed,' blocking certificates of existence, notarized share transfers, foreign-exchange forms, and fund closings; two consecutive unrenewed years permit administrative strike-off of the merchant registry by the Chamber on SIC order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros Aprobados e Informe de Gestión (Deposit of Shareholder-Approved Financial Statements and Management Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of corporate domicile (archived in the entity's RUES dossier)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of the year following fiscal year-end, filed together with the mercantile renewal; shareholder approval must occur within 3 months of year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Mercantile renewal is rejected without the deposit; SIC may impose fines up to 200 SMMLV (≈ USD 68,000) and order corrective filing; false accounts expose directors to personal liability under Law 222/1995 and register-falsity sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (Annual UBO Declaration Renewal in the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) — Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales web portal; data shared with UIAF and DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during January 1 – March 31; qualifying share transfers require an updated declaration within 15 business days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to COP 48,625,000 (≈ USD 11,700) per omitted or inaccurate declaration under SIC Resolution 2022103380; continued non-compliance adds daily default penalties and blocks renewals; deliberate concealment triggers AML/UIAF examination.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de Asamblea Anual de Accionistas y Protocolización de Libros (Annual Shareholders' Meeting Minutes; Minute Book Updates and Statutory Register Audit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company's rubricated statutory registers (Libro de Actas and Libro de Registro de Accionistas); Chamber of Commerce verifies rubrication upon inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting held within 3 months after fiscal year-end (by March 31); S.A.S. may substitute the meeting with unanimous written shareholder decisions under Law 1258/2008 Article 22; minutes recorded before the first transaction of the following period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unfiled minutes render accounts unapprovable and block the Chamber deposit; non-rubricated registers lose evidentiary weight and trigger SIC fines for irregular books under Código de Comercio Articles 43, 44, and 57; directors remain personally liable for omitted approvals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (Annual Third-Party Tax Information Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (electronic filing per the annual DIAN schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between January and July following the reporting year, per the DIAN resolution schedule based on the last digit of the NIT; management-fee withholdings and investor payments are the relevant data for a VC GP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to 7,800 UVT (COP ≈ 388 million, ≈ USD 93,000) under Article 651 of the Tax Statute for non-filing or erroneous data, plus rejection of deductions and foreign credits otherwise supported by the information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal is mandatory for an S.A.S. when, at the preceding year-end: (i) total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (COP 7.12 billion for 2025, ≈ USD 1.72 million); (ii) gross annual revenues exceed 3,000 SMMLV (COP 4.27 billion, ≈ USD 1.03 million); (iii) more than 200 workers are engaged; or (iv) the by-laws or a public-interest classification require it. An early-stage VC GP entity below these tests may dispense with the statutory auditor; external audit, when performed, must be led by a CPA registered with the Junta Central de Contadores.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Accounting Standards under Decree 2420/2015, as amended by Decree 2483/2018: Grupo 1 adopts full IFRS; Grupo 2 adopts IFRS for SMEs; Grupo 3 adopts micro-entity GAAP. A VC GP managing an early-stage fund normally qualifies for Grupo 2 IFRS for SMEs unless consolidation or public-interest thresholds require full IFRS; statements are presented in COP in nominal currency.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. GP must refresh its UBO declaration annually even with no ownership change, identifying every natural person owning at least 5% of capital, voting rights, or profits, or exercising direct or indirect control; foreign VC LPs require look-through to the individual investors. Any share transfer must be reflected in the Register of Shareholders and communicated to the SIC within 15 business days of the transfer; the annual confirmation is due during the January–March window. Omissions give rise to fines up to COP 48.6 million (≈ USD 11,700) and treatment of the register as defective for all mercantile purposes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Shareholders' Assembly Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Board of Directors' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva), where a board exists
Inventory and Balance Sheet Ledger (Libro de Inventarios y Balances)
General Journal (Libro Diario) and General Ledger (Libro Mayor)
NIT certificate, Certificate of Existence and Representation, and sealed by-laws dossier

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$ 250 – US$ 1,800 per year (commercial registered office and legal notice/correspondence agent in Bogotá, Medellín, or Cali; physical occupancy excluded)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$ 5,500 – US$ 20,000 per year for a local CPA-firm statutory audit; fee varies with the number of portfolio vehicles and consolidation work
